publicationDecision.scope: Publish one bounded tirzepatide specialist-oncology research summary and add one new sponsor-submitted specialist-population trial to the existing survodutide programme. This is editorial authorisation, not clinical approval.

entries.name: Tirzepatide in endometrial-cancer research
entries.stage: Early Phase 1 recruiting; separate Phase 2 not yet recruiting
entries.summary: Two UNC Lineberger registry records study short pre-operative tirzepatide use in people with obesity and endometrial cancer or endometrial intraepithelial neoplasia. The 20-participant Early Phase 1 record reports an actual 27 April 2026 start and is recruiting; the separate 40-participant Phase 2 record remains not yet recruiting.
entries.ukAuthorisation: Mounjaro's established UK weight-management position is described separately. These registry records do not establish UK marketing authorisation for preventing, treating or improving endometrial cancer or endometrial intraepithelial neoplasia.
entries.nhsEngland: No NICE recommendation or NHS England access is established for tirzepatide as an endometrial-cancer intervention.
entries.supply: An established weight-management supply route does not establish lawful supply for these investigational oncology uses, pharmacy stock or sale by SHIFT.
entries.limitations: Neither record has posted results. Recruitment and an actual study start do not establish safety, pathological response, cancer benefit or an authorised indication. The studies are small and the Phase 2 start and completion dates remain estimates.

fields.summaryToAppend: A sponsor-submitted Phase 3 SYNCHRONIZE-HERA record, first posted 30 September 2026, studies survodutide in an estimated 600 women going through or after menopause.
fields.limitationsToAppend: SYNCHRONIZE-HERA remains not yet recruiting, has no posted results and lists 31 October 2026 as an estimated start; the record does not establish that dosing has begun or that outcomes differ by menopausal status.

preservedCandidates.title: Finerenone with semaglutide in non-diabetic obesity and chronic kidney disease with albuminuria
preservedCandidates.reason: The investigator-led record remains not yet recruiting, lists an already-past September 2026 estimated start, reports phase as not applicable and has no listed locations or posted results. It is retained for follow-up rather than presented as an active medicine-development programme.

discoveryDecision.included: The tirzepatide records add a distinct specialist oncology context with one verifiably recruiting study. SYNCHRONIZE-HERA is added to the existing survodutide programme rather than counted as a new medicine.
discoveryDecision.plannedVersusCompleted: Only NCT07065552 has an actual start and recruiting status. All other start and completion dates are estimates, and no results are posted.
discoveryDecision.ukPosition: Established UK weight-management positions are not transferred to oncology or menopause-specific research questions.
discoveryDecision.monitoring: No automatic source baseline, successful configured-source check or medical-review renewal is created by this publication.
discoveryDecision.coverage: The current registry pass is not exhaustive. The semaglutide-finerenone candidate remains explicitly incomplete and unpublished pending evidence of actual activity.
